he.text: Say from אַשְׁרֵי page 1, till שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה page 4, after which say the following—

en.text: Say from “for thou hearest prayer,” page 2, till “for it is great,” page 7ᶜ after which say the following—

editorial_expansion: The Hebrew cue names Ashrei (1) through Shomea tefillah (4), while English names for thou hearest prayer with page 2 and ends for it is great (7). For thou hearest prayer actually occurs at the end of Lekha Adonai (printed 4); the English start citation is inconsistent. The expanded bilingual service editorially follows the complete Hebrew preliminary range through Shomea tefillah, before the reprinted Selah lanu. Retain the divergent documentary cues and the visible superscript-like mark after 7 (rendered ᶜ), whose meaning remains unresolved.
